title: DGP Braneworld Gravity (Dvali–Gabadadze–Porrati)
efc_relevance: 4D brane embedded in 5D bulk; gravity leaks to extra dimension at late times. Original self-accelerating branch ruled out by growth; normal branch (nDGP) survives as perturbation-sector test bed. Standard benchmark for modified-gravity μ–Σ analyses. EFC must be compared head-to-head with nDGP on weak-lensing Σ and growth fσ8.
ledger_action: Logged as canonical extra-dimensional competitor. Required benchmark in perturbation-sector tests (ledger_perturbationsector_valley).
